content_fields.title: Test separation of deployment configuration files (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Add a check that fails the pipeline when deployment configuration or secrets appear in the repository.
content_fields.finding: There is a single committed compose file holding environment values, so separation cannot be verified.
content_fields.current_code:
environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=admin
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password
      - POSTGRES_SERVER=db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - POSTGRES_DB=restaurant
content_fields.required_fix:
# .github/workflows/ci.yml
      - name: Block committed deployment config and secrets
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)\.env$|(^|/)deploy/.*\.env$'; then
            echo "Committed environment file detected" >&2; exit 1
          fi
          grep -nE 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=' docker-compose.yml && exit 1 || true
criteria: The pipeline fails when an environment file is committed.
The pipeline fails when a credential literal appears in compose or Dockerfile.
